description.p: XZram provides a desktop GUI for managing zram, swap files, partitions, and sysctl tuning on systemd-based Linux distributions.

Fix silent partial applies when the command-line tool is newer than the installed privileged helper: unknown settings are now rejected with a clear message, and the CLI asks you to upgrade first. The local Arch PKGBUILD builds again.

OOM protection now shields the desktop session so apps are killed before the compositor and shell. Recommended defaults add MGLRU thrashing prevention, background THP compaction, smaller dirty-writeback batches and gentler dentry/inode cache reclaim.

OOM protection and swap sizing: recommended defaults can enable systemd-oomd with kill policies, grow an undersized distro swapfile, and warn about disk swap on hard drives. Doctor now reports past OOM kills, memory pressure, swap headroom and undersized disk overflow.

Security and reliability release: safer swapfile handling, crash-safe configuration writes, snapshot restore that keeps unrelated mounts and removes swapfiles added since, automatic rollback when apply fails, a hardened daemon, and a GUI that no longer freezes during privileged operations.

Fix zram status/doctor misreading a sysfs field as a bogus compression-stream count, warn when zram is nearly full and disk swap is absorbing overflow, and fix a D-Bus startup registration race in xzramd.
Linked auto-optimize across GUI tabs, recommend size scales, and async linked optimize so Stage stays usable.
GUI CLI-first runner, settings and snapshot tabs, safer recommended defaults, and clearer actions.
